subject: Console & API enablement — scheduling + dry-run
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Console walkthrough + API enablement for Acme PDX team

Hi Olga,

We're ready to move forward with a combined console walkthrough and API enablement for our PDX engineering team. Ideally we'd like a 90-minute session covering:
- Console: permission model, routing, rollout controls, cost/latency dashboards
- API: authentication, streaming responses, batching, and common integration patterns
- A short Q&A + next steps (mutual action items)

Our core attendees: myself (engineering lead) and Sarah Thompson (integration PM). We're in PDT (UTC-7). Our preferred window last week of April is Tue/Wed mornings (PDT) but we can be flexible. Suggested range: 2027-04-19 to 2027-04-21, 09:00–12:00 PDT.

Can you propose 2 slots and let us know if Redwood needs any pre-reads or service account details? Also would you recommend a 30-minute dry-run with our SREs prior to the main session?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Engineering Lead, Acme Retail
[jordan.lee@acme-retail.com]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.lee@acme-retail.com
Date: 2027-03-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Console walkthrough + API enablement for Acme PDX team

Rafael / Mina — forwarding Acme's scheduling request. They want a combined 90-minute session in the week of Apr 19 (PDT) and asked about a 30-min dry-run.

Ask: can you two coordinate 2 candidate time slots (prefer mornings) + a suggested dry-run slot (24 hours before the session)? Also confirm if we need any scoped service account or short pre-read (I think a 1-page checklist is enough).

I'll hold the thread with Jordan copied so we can propose directly.

Thanks,
Olga
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.lee@acme-retail.com, sarah.thompson@acme-retail.com
Date: 2027-03-28T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Console walkthrough + API enablement for Acme PDX team

Thanks, Olga. Proposing two main-session slots and one dry-run:

Option A: Tue 2027-04-20 09:30–11:00 PDT (90m)
Option B: Wed 2027-04-21 10:00–11:30 PDT (90m)

Dry-run (recommended): Mon 2027-04-19 10:00–10:30 PDT — 30 minutes, runbook & SRE checks only.

Pre-reads: we'll send a one-page "enablement checklist" and the console demo plan. For API we need a service account token with the minimum scope for a demo (read-only model calls) — we can provide a short RBAC doc.

I'll attach the quick checklist and draft slides (see attachments) and will prepare a short runbook for the dry-run.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Attachments: console-dryrun-slides.pdf (pptx stub), redwood_enablement_ops_checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: sarah.thompson@acme-retail.com
Date: 2027-03-29T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Fwd: Request: Console walkthrough + API enablement for Acme PDX team

Thanks, Rafael — and thanks Olga.

Option B looks closest to what a lot of our team can make, but we have a standing SLT review at 10:00 PDT on the 21st that sometimes runs long. Could we shift Option B by +1 hour (11:00–12:30 PDT) instead? If not, Option A also works but we'd prefer Option B shifted if possible.

Dry-run on Mon 4/19 at 10:00 PDT works for our SRE (please send the runbook).

For the service account: we'll provision a demo token with read-only model access and send it to you via our secure transfer (we'll reply-all with the link once it's ready).

Jordan

Subject: Confirmed: Console & API enablement — Wed 2027-04-21 11:00–12:30 PDT (plus dry-run)

Jordan / Sarah —

Confirmed per your request: main session is Wed, 2027-04-21 11:00–12:30 PDT (90m). Dry-run will be Mon, 2027-04-19 10:00–10:30 PDT. I've attached the ops checklist and the draft slides Rafael mentioned.

Action items for Acme before the dry-run:
- Provision a demo service account token with read-only model access and share via your secure transfer link (reply-all once uploaded).
- Add the three SREs who will join the dry-run to the calendar invite.

What we'll cover in the dry-run (30m):
- Confirm service account/token scopes
- Validate network reachability and CORS if using browser clients
- Run a short live API call and confirm streaming behavior
- Confirm console role access for the attendees

What we'll cover in the main session (90m):
- 30m Console walkthrough (RBAC, routing, rollouts, dashboard tips)
- 40m API patterns + live integration examples (batching/kv cache/streaming)
- 20m Q&A + mutual action plan (next steps & owners)

I've attached: redwood_enablement_ops_checklist.pdf, console-dryrun-slides.pdf, and added a calendar invite (acme_console_session.ics). If you prefer a different calendar format let me know.

Looking forward to it — I'll send the calendar invites separately.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0124
